idea-plugin.name: Flutter SDK Sync Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps the Flutter SDK selection of a project in sync with the SDK provided by FVM (Flutter Version Management).

After an fvm use, the IDE is pointed at the newly selected SDK and the switch is propagated: the SDK is refreshed, pub get runs for every pub root, and the device daemon is restarted. No IDE restart needed.

The SDK is discovered from the project's .fvm directory, so FVM does not have to be on the IDE's PATH. Other version managers are not supported yet.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google LLC. It complements the official Flutter plugin.
